references.text: The likeness of the manna that was given to the Israelites and satisfied them in the wilderness.
God's ability to satisfy the hungry, as reflected in the miracle.
The invitation to all who are thirsty and hungry to come to the Lord to be satisfied.
A parallel event where Jesus feeds 5,000 men, plus women and children, with five loaves and two fish.
Another event where Jesus feeds a crowd, this time 4,000 men, plus women and children, with seven loaves and a few small fish.
